subject.title: fix(mxc): reject oversized sandbox policy files

question: Should MXC permanently reject every sandbox policy file larger than 1 MiB, including currently valid policies that may have relied on larger files?
rationale: The descriptor-pinned read is a narrow safety repair, but the chosen fixed threshold deliberately changes startup compatibility for existing operator configuration and is not established by an existing public limit.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB hard limit
options.body: Approve the documented cap as the supported MXC policy-file contract and merge after refreshing the branch against current main.

options.title: Use a different compatibility policy
options.body: Ask for a revised cap or an owner-approved migration/alternative if existing policy files above 1 MiB must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB hard limit
recommendation.body: Approve the documented cap as the supported MXC policy-file contract and merge after refreshing the branch against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation and proof, though final compatibility direction should be confirmed by the MXC code owner.
